topic: Capstone Demonstration, Review, and Future Enhancements
learningObjectives: Present the architecture, features, and technical decisions of a Java capstone project.
Review the project against functionality, quality, security, and deployment requirements.
Identify realistic improvements and future development opportunities.

activities.title: Capstone Architecture Review
activities.instruction: Explore the complete system from requirements to deployment.

content.concept: A final architecture review connects the project's requirements, frontend, backend, data layer, authentication, integrations, testing, and deployment into one system view.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Define the user and business problems the project solves.
Provides the interface through which users interact with the system.
Verifies identity and controls access to protected resources.
Provide capabilities integrated from outside the core application.
Runs the application in a target environment.

activities.title: Demo Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Build a clear technical demonstration sequence.

content.concept: A strong project demonstration can introduce the problem, explain the architecture, demonstrate important features, show implementation and testing evidence, and finish with deployment and future improvements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Final Quality Review
activities.instruction: Explore the areas that should be reviewed before completing the capstone.

content.concept: A final review should verify that the system works as intended and that important concerns such as security, testing, performance, documentation, and deployment have been addressed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Verify that required features behave according to the requirements.
Review structure, readability, maintainability, and appropriate design.
Check authentication, authorization, validation, secrets, and other security controls.
Review automated and manual evidence that important behavior has been tested.
Investigate important bottlenecks and resource usage.
Ensure setup, usage, architecture, and API information are documented.
Verify that the application can be configured and operated in its target environment.

activities.title: Future Enhancement Roadmap
activities.instruction: Arrange a realistic sequence for planning future improvements.

content.concept: Future development should begin by identifying real limitations or user needs, prioritizing improvements, implementing them incrementally, and validating their impact.
